experiment.hypothesis: A can map its persisted ordinal intent assessment into the existing bounded Strategy.retrieval_depth field so narrow high-confidence Buying retrieves fewer candidates without teaching B a second confidence policy.
experiment.primary_behavior_changed: Optional A-owned high-confidence narrow-Buying candidate-depth selection

experiment_discipline.consequence: The favorable aggregate result cannot be promoted to a retained default because no contemporaneous keep/revert gate was recorded and the gain is concentrated in fold_4.

policy.fixed_fallback: With the flag disabled, or when IntentAssessment is unavailable or the adaptive gate is false, preserve the B9 intent-and-active-constraint mapping.
policy.B_consumption: B reads only the validated bounded request.strategy.retrieval_depth value; raw IntentAssessment and confidence do not cross the seam.
policy.calibration_boundary: IntentAssessment confidence remains an A-owned ordinal stability band, not a calibrated probability.

evaluation_boundary.offline_target_use: Development-only metric and session comparison; no evaluator field crossed SessionState, Strategy, RetrievalRequest, diagnostics, retrieval, or ranking.

details.public_0135: Buying hit remains turn 2; best rank worsens 4 to 6.
details.public_0178: Buying hit arrives earlier at turn 5 instead of 7; best rank worsens 7 to 9.
details.public_0195: Browsing changes from miss after 10 turns to hit at turn 3, rank 2.

session_changes.response_count_difference_explanation: Candidate has 716 versus 725 responses: public_0195 saves seven turns and public_0178 saves two turns.

cost.interpretation: Candidate counts are deterministic observations, but the response mix differs because two sessions finish earlier; do not attribute the full aggregate mean reduction to depth selection alone.
cost.timing_note: Default and candidate reports were run concurrently; their timing and RSS are not used for a causal cost claim.

verification.red_test: The opt-in high-confidence narrow-Buying test returned depth 80 before the candidate and expected 60.
targeted_properties: the default flag is false and preserves B9 depth behavior
A owns the confidence-band decision and B consumes only Strategy.retrieval_depth
the optional rule requires Buying, high ordinal confidence, and at least two active constraints
effective depth remains max(top_k, selected floor)
medium confidence and missing IntentAssessment preserve the prior fixed mapping

decision_rationale: The candidate improves every aggregate metric, gains one hit, and loses no hit.
Buying MRR regresses and both changed Buying sessions have worse best rank, despite one arriving two turns earlier.
Fold 1 regresses slightly, folds 2 and 3 are parity, and the positive fold result is concentrated in fold 4.
No contemporaneous keep/revert gate was recorded before observing results, so a retained-default decision would be post hoc.
The candidate therefore remains reproducible behind an explicit disabled-by-default flag; B9 remains the default runtime.
next_module: R4 integrated selection and freeze with B9 as the default B route
